title: Website Development Cost in India: A Complete 2024 Guide
excerpt: A transparent breakdown of how much it really costs to build a professional business website in India, from templates to custom web apps.
content_paragraphs: One of the most common questions business owners ask when transitioning into the digital space is:
Understanding the Pricing Spectrum

In India, website development costs can range from as little as ₹5,000 for a basic template-based site, all the way to ₹10,00,000+ for complex, custom-coded web applications. To make an informed decision, you need to understand what you are paying for at each tier.
Tier 1: Template Websites

These are usually built using pre-made WordPress themes or basic drag-and-drop builders. They are cheap and fast to set up, but they suffer from bloated code, extremely slow loading speeds, and poor SEO capabilities.
Tier 2: Custom React/Vite SPAs

Hidden Costs You Must Consider
When budgeting for a website, many business owners only consider the initial development cost. However, maintaining a digital presence incurs ongoing expenses.

Why Cheap Websites Are Actually Expensive

If you pay ₹5,000 for a website, you are likely getting a site that takes 8 seconds to load. Studies show that 53% of mobile users abandon a site that takes longer than 3 seconds to load. A cheap website actively drives away potential customers, costing you thousands of rupees in lost revenue over time.
Investing in a custom, fast, and SEO-optimized website acts as a 24/7 salesperson for your business, ultimately generating an ROI that vastly outweighs the initial development cost.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to build a custom website?
A standard custom 5-page business website typically takes our team 2 to 4 weeks to design, develop, test, and deploy.
Do I own the source code?
Yes, unlike subscription platforms like Wix or Shopify, when you hire us for custom development, you retain 100% ownership of the final source code.

How long does it take to learn German A1?
With our intensive coaching, you can clear the A1 level and pass the Goethe-Zertifikat A1 exam within 6 to 8 weeks of consistent study.
Is German very hard for English speakers?

Because English and German are both Germanic languages, they share thousands of cognates (words that sound the same). The grammar takes practice, but the vocabulary is surprisingly familiar for English speakers.
